verdict.rationale: Modular, dependency-injected architecture is a fair axis for a web framework, but the evidence pack never mentions a dependency-injection system, providers, or injectable services in Next.js. Component composition, file-system layouts and Multi-Zones micro-frontends are adjacent modularity features, not DI building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize my app into modular, dependency-injected building blocks
